evals.name: worktree-til
evals.prompt: Turn these notes into a short TIL draft: 'git worktree add gives every agent its own checkout. TIL the worktrees share one object store, so a fetch in one shows up in all of them. But each worktree needs its own dependency install; in my repo that's about 40 seconds per worktree.'
evals.expected_output: A short draft in TIL mode that keeps to the one discovery in the notes, adds no facts beyond them, and passes the repository checks, with a hero and diagram from post-layout.
assertions: Adds one draft post with published: false in src/content/writing/
The draft reads as a TIL: one discovery, its context, and why it matters, without essay sections
Every claim and number in the draft appears in the notes or a cited source
The prose names no employer or employer product
The search title (seoTitle, or title without one) is 44 characters or fewer
cspell and bun test pass, and the final message says they ran

evals.name: vendor-drift-audit
evals.prompt: Audit my published posts for vendor drift. Don't change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Per-post findings against the vendor-drift checklist and the four neutrality questions, with no files changed and reframing or retiring left to the author.
assertions: Covers every post with published: true and only those
Gives each post a one-sentence 'so what' for a builder outside the author's company, or flags that it can't
Applies the four neutrality questions from .github/instructions/writing.instructions.md
Flags titles, seoTitles, descriptions, or headings that name a product instead of a problem
Asks the author before reframing, retiring, or renaming any post
